interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the "layer_surface" role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-ordering.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: wl_surface has already been assigned a layer_surface role

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a Surface

request.description: Create a layer surface for a given surface.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request indicates that the client will not use the layer_shell object any more. Objects created through this instance are not affected.

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface, for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a Given output.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor points of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: configures the exclusive zone of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area of the surface.

request.name: set_margin

description.summary: sets the margin of the surface

request.description: Requests that the surface be placed some distance away from the anchor edge.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity
request.description: Set how keyboard focus is requested for this layer surface.

request.name: get_popup

description.summary: assign this surface as a popup parent

request.description: This request indicates that the child xdg_popup surface should be parented to this layer surface.

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client would like to accept a configure event, it must respond with this request.

request.name: destroy
request.description: This request destroys the layer surface.

event.name: configure
event.description: The configure event asks the client to resize its surface.

event.name: closed
event.description: The closed event is sent by the compositor when the surface will no longer be shown.
